papers.title: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
papers.abstract: How multimodal language models should encode visual input remains up for debate. Most models use a pretrained vision encoder, while some recent recipes train the encoder from scratch with the language model or remove it entirely. Vision encoders bundle together three design choices: a visual prior from upstream pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and pre-fusion placement of that capacity (i.e., before the multimodal backbone). Because published models also differ in data, architecture, and compute, comparing them cannot isolate the effect of each choice. We disentangle these choices via a controlled framework where we pretrain all models from scratch on common data and compare them on visual question answering and language benchmarks at matched lifetime compute. We find that the visual prior is not necessary; an encoder trained jointly from scratch is on par with a pretrained one, without a separate training stage. What matters instead is dedicated vision capacity: an encoder-free model trails on visual understanding even when its backbone is enlarged by the encoder's parameter count. Yet that capacity need not precede multimodal fusion, as vision-only modules added in-fusion to early backbone layers perform comparably to a pre-fusion encoder and can lower time to first token. These results also hold across backbone sizes, when encoder pretraining is treated as free, and when starting from a pretrained language model. Overall, our findings favor dedicated vision capacity trained jointly with the backbone and placed early within it.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态语言模型应如何编码视觉输入仍无定论，已有模型在视觉先验、专用视觉容量和融合前放置等设计上相互纠缠，难以隔离各自影响。
ai_summary.method: 作者提出一个受控实验框架，在相同数据和匹配的总训练计算下从零预训练所有模型，并在视觉问答与语言基准上比较不同设计选择，同时覆盖不同骨干规模、将编码器预训练视为免费以及从预训练语言模型初始化等设定。
ai_summary.result: 实验发现预训练视觉先验并非必要，从零联合训练的编码器可与预训练编码器相当；真正关键的是专用视觉容量，而无编码器模型即使扩大骨干参数量仍在视觉理解上落后；该容量不必置于多模态融合之前，早期骨干层内融合的纯视觉模块表现相当并可降低首 token 延迟。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过受控框架解耦并分别检验视觉先验、专用视觉容量和融合前放置这三个常被混在一起的设计选择。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态模型视觉编码架构提供了可操作的实证指导，支持将专用视觉容量与骨干联合训练并早期置于骨干内部。
ai_summary.org: Meta AI（FAIR）

papers.title: Asymmetric Multimodal Learning with Decomposed JEPAs
papers.abstract: Cross-modal alignment is the standard objective for building multimodal representations. We show that alignment as a \emph{sole} objective is lossy wherever modalities are informationally asymmetric---where neither can express what the other carries. Visual question answering is an obvious case: a question is a selective relational operator probing a dense visual field whose fine-grained features no query recovers, so what alignment preserves is not what the task requires. We prove an \textbf{Alignment Redundancy Bound}: alignment-only Dirichlet energy minimization retains at most the redundant information atom $\Red(Z; X_1, X_2)$, annihilating private modality-specific structure $\Unq(Z; X_m)$ and cross-modal synergy $\Syn(Z; X_1, X_2)$.   We introduce \textbf{Decomposed JEPA (D-JEPA)}, which factorizes latents into an aligned shared core and private modality-specific fibers. The shared core retains most of the structure alignment targets; the private fibers recover what alignment discards, via contextual masked prediction and asymmetric cross-subspace independence. Under information asymmetry, alignment-only training undergoes catastrophic semantic collapse on compositional reasoning benchmarks, surviving only on binary queries. D-JEPA averts this collapse, substantially improving downstream accuracy over both alignment-only and alignment-with-reconstruction baselines, and restoring a positive multimodal synergy gap in place of the baseline's inverted gap. Information-theoretic audits confirm that D-JEPA recovers most of the mutual information available from a frozen backbone, and causal fiber-swap interventions demonstrate that the recovered information is causally localized in the private fibers.

ai_summary.problem: 论文指出跨模态对齐作为唯一目标在模态信息不对称时是有损的，会丢失私有模态特有结构和跨模态协同信息，导致多模态表征无法保留任务所需信息并可能引发语义崩溃。
ai_summary.method: 提出Decomposed JEPA（D-JEPA），将潜表征分解为对齐共享核心和私有模态纤维；共享核心保留对齐目标的主要结构，私有纤维通过上下文掩码预测与非对称跨子空间独立性恢复被对齐丢弃的信息。
ai_summary.result: 论文证明Alignment Redundancy Bound，表明仅对齐训练最多保留冗余信息并消除私有结构与协同；实验显示仅对齐训练在组合推理基准上发生语义崩溃且仅二元查询存活，而D-JEPA避免崩溃、显著提升下游准确率，并恢复正的多模态协同差距。
ai_summary.novelty: 从信息论上揭示仅对齐目标存在冗余瓶颈，并提出共享核心加私有纤维分解的JEPA架构，在信息不对称多模态场景中恢复私有与协同信息。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态表征学习提供了超越单纯对齐的分解式范式，对VQA等不对称模态任务以及世界模型中的多模态融合具有指导意义。

papers.title: Spatial Foundry: A Multimodal Dataset for Spatial Intelligence
papers.abstract: Spatial intelligence requires connecting visual observations to the geometry, objects, and persistent state of an environment. Images alone leave these relationships implicit, while disconnected annotations make it difficult to study appearance, camera motion, and scene changes under a common reference. We introduce Spatial Foundry, a collection of 5,280 furnished residential 3D scene configurations with editable assets and aligned visual, geometric, and temporal data. Its modalities include floor plans, perspective and panoramic RGB, metric depth, point clouds, meshes, instance-level 3D bounding boxes, and camera trajectories paired with video. Shared scene coordinates link observations across views and time; editable source scenes enable additional camera paths and controlled object changes. We describe the data representation and construction workflow, and discuss applications in floor-plan-conditioned 3D generation, geometric reconstruction, instance-level perception, camera-conditioned video generation, shared world modeling, and scene editing. Controlled camera and scene variations support spatial perception and world-model research. The public project page provides videos and an interactive colored point-cloud preview.

ai_summary.problem: 空间智能研究需要将视觉观测与场景几何、物体和持久状态关联起来，但现有数据要么仅有图像使关系隐含，要么标注割裂，难以在统一参考下研究外观、相机运动和场景变化。
ai_summary.method: 作者构建了 Spatial Foundry 数据集，包含 5,280 个可编辑的带家具住宅 3D 场景配置，并提供平面图、透视/全景 RGB、度量深度、点云、网格、实例级 3D 包围盒以及与视频配对的相机轨迹等多模态数据。所有观测通过共享场景坐标关联，并支持额外相机路径和受控物体变化。
ai_summary.result: 该数据集支持平面图条件 3D 生成、几何重建、实例级感知、相机条件视频生成、共享世界建模和场景编辑等应用；受控相机与场景变化有助于空间感知和世界模型研究，但摘要未给出定量实验结果。
ai_summary.novelty: 其创新在于提供可编辑、多模态对齐、跨视角与跨时间共享场景坐标的住宅 3D 场景数据集，并支持受控相机和物体变化。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作为空间智能、3D/视频生成、具身感知和世界模型研究提供了统一的多模态数据基础，有望推动相关基准与模型发展。

papers.title: XBot-Omni: An Omni-Modal Model for Embodied Understanding and Interaction
papers.abstract: Embodied interaction requires an agent to integrate multimodal perception with verbal and nonverbal behaviors to effectively communicate its intentions, including speech, body motion, and facial expressions. We present XBot-Omni, a Thinker--Talker--Actor architecture that extends the Omni paradigm to robotic modalities, including body motion and facial expressions, with ``X'' representing the extensibility to robotic-specific modalities. The Thinker processes text, images, audio, and video to formulate contextually appropriate responses, which are then realized by the Talker and Actor through speech and coordinated bodily expressions, respectively. In this report, we innovatively introduce the concept of ``Actor'' as a dedicated component for embodied agents: a coordinated, streaming module that leverages the native representations of the Thinker and Talker within an end-to-end pipeline, introducing only modest latency overhead. This unified architecture enables multimodal generation conditioned on omni-modal inputs directly to prevent information loss in staged designs. We comprehensively evaluate XBot-Omni across seven benchmarks, demonstrating strong multimodal understanding capabilities on both general-domain and robot-centric videos, as well as high-quality, natural, and well-coordinated motion generation. Furthermore, our results validate its capability to generate embodied multimodal responses directly from omni inputs, meeting the diverse requirements of embodied interaction. XBot-Omni enables robots not only to perceive the omni world but also to express themselves through speech and bodily behaviors, extending Omni models from conversational interaction to embodied communication in physical environments.

ai_summary.problem: 具身智能体需要将多模态感知（语音、肢体动作、面部表情等）与语言和非语言行为统一整合，而现有 Omni 模型局限于对话交互，缺乏面向机器人的动作与表情生成能力，且分阶段设计易造成信息损失。
ai_summary.method: 提出 XBot-Omni 的 Thinker–Talker–Actor 架构：Thinker 处理文本、图像、音频、视频并生成上下文响应，Talker 与 Actor 分别将其落实为语音与协调的肢体/面部表达；Actor 作为端到端流式模块复用 Thinker 与 Talker 的原生表示，以较低延迟实现全模态输入条件下的多模态生成。
ai_summary.result: 在七个基准上验证了其在通用域与机器人中心视频上的强多模态理解能力，以及高质量、自然且协调的动作生成，并可直接从全模态输入生成具身多模态响应。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将 Omni 范式从对话扩展至机器人专属模态，引入专职的 Actor 流式组件，以统一端到端架构避免分阶段设计的信息损失。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动 Omni 模型从对话交互走向物理环境中的具身沟通，为世界模型与具身智能体的多模态感知-表达一体化提供架构参考。

papers.title: From Foundation VLM to Versatile Driving VLM: A Triplet Incremental Training Approach
papers.abstract: Adapting general Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to Autonomous Driving (AD) is thought to require heavy 3D spatial priors or intrusive architectural overhauls to compensate for a lack of spatial grounding. In this work, we present a counterintuitive pilot study: off-the-shelf general VLMs already exhibit remarkable adaptability across diverse driving tasks, while precise metric depth remains the primary missing link, a bottleneck readily addressable via onboard sensors and depth foundation models. To this end, we introduce the Triplet Incremental Training Framework, a non-intrusive paradigm that seamlessly instills 3D geometric awareness into a general VLM backbone while fully preserving its open-world capabilities. Driven by automatically constructed (image, depth, QA pair) triplets, our framework operates via a unified tri-stream training pipeline: an unfrozen primary VLM stream to adapt to driving tasks, an auxiliary depth stream that guides the visual backbone to implicitly imagine 3D scene geometry via explicit geometric constraints, and a frozen twin VLM stream employing logit-level KL distillation to prevent semantic drift. Crucially, the auxiliary depth branch is discarded during deployment, ensuring the enhanced geometric awareness comes with zero inference overhead. We evaluate our framework across four major benchmarks targeting four diverse capabilities spanning 3D spatial perception, driving-oriented language reasoning, end-to-end planning, and general multimodal understanding. Our approach outperforms state-of-the-art driving VLMs, rivals domain-specific expert models in 3D perception, and successfully retains its original general reasoning capabilities. This demonstrates that Triplet Incremental Training offers a unified, deployment-ready paradigm for transforming general foundation models into robust driving intelligences.

ai_summary.problem: 通用视觉语言模型（VLM）适配自动驾驶时缺乏3D空间 grounding，现有方案往往依赖重型3D先验或侵入式架构改造。论文要验证通用VLM是否已具备多任务驾驶适应性，并解决其精确度量深度/3D几何感知不足这一关键瓶颈。
ai_summary.method: 提出Triplet Incremental Training框架，基于自动构建的（图像、深度、QA对）三元组进行统一三流训练：主VLM流不冻结以适配驾驶任务，辅助深度流通过显式几何约束引导视觉骨干隐式想象3D场景几何，冻结的双VLM流用logit级KL蒸馏防止语义漂移。部署时丢弃辅助深度分支，实现零推理开销的3D几何感知增强。
ai_summary.result: 在覆盖3D空间感知、驾驶语言推理、端到端规划和通用多模态理解的四类基准上，方法优于当前SOTA驾驶VLM，3D感知可媲美领域专家模型，同时成功保留原始通用推理能力。
ai_summary.novelty: 用自动三元组训练和非侵入式辅助深度流+冻结双VLM蒸馏，将3D几何意识注入通用VLM且部署零额外开销。
ai_summary.relevance: 为通用基础模型低成本、可部署地适配自动驾驶提供了一条保留开放世界能力的统一范式，对VLM与具身/驾驶智能结合有参考价值。

papers.title: NSDL: Neuro-Symbolic Division of Labor for Multi-Robot Task Planning
papers.abstract: Planning for a heterogeneous robot team from a scene image and an instruction involves two kinds of decisions. Some must be judged from the scene: which goals are already met, how the task splits, and which robot does what. Others follow from these and can be computed: prerequisite actions, handoffs between robots, and timing. We argue that each kind should go to the component suited to it: a small vision-language model learns the first, and a deterministic solver computes the second. In NSDL (Neuro-Symbolic Division of Labor), the trained model writes its judgments as a plan sketch, which lists the goals that still need action and the intended steps in order, each with a robot. The solver expands the sketch into an executable joint plan. The model calls two tools, a detector for evidence and the solver, and is trained with the solver in the loop. We evaluate on the public VIKI-L2 benchmark and on LOCUS-Bench, a new benchmark that grades the two kinds of difficulty separately. NSDL outperforms end-to-end planners and formalize-then-plan baselines on both benchmarks and with three backbones from 3B to 8B; the 7B model reaches 97.0% out-of-distribution accuracy on VIKI-L2. Ordering and scheduling errors nearly disappear once the solver writes the structure; the remaining failures are misjudged states, and most goals the model misses are ones it never lists. Code, model weights, and LOCUS-Bench are publicly available at https://github.com/Xincheng-Tan/NSDL.

ai_summary.problem: 论文研究如何从场景图像和自然语言指令出发，为异构多机器人团队进行联合任务规划，并合理分配视觉判断与符号计算两类决策。
ai_summary.method: 提出NSDL神经符号分工框架：小型视觉语言模型负责判断目标是否完成、任务拆分和机器人分配，并输出计划草图；确定性求解器负责展开前置动作、交接和时序，生成可执行联合计划。模型调用检测器与求解器工具，并采用求解器在环训练。
ai_summary.result: 在VIKI-L2和新提出的LOCUS-Bench上，NSDL优于端到端规划器和formalize-then-plan基线，3B至8B三种骨干均有效，7B模型在VIKI-L2分布外准确率达97.0%；排序与调度错误几乎消失，剩余错误主要来自状态误判和遗漏目标。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是将多机器人任务规划中的感知判断与符号计算显式分工，并让视觉语言模型生成计划草图、求解器在环扩展为可执行计划。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作为具身智能和多机器人Agent提供了一种神经符号协同规划范式，强调小模型判断与确定性求解器计算的互补性。

papers.title: Rethinking Actions: Continuity-Aware Priors for World-Model Planning
papers.abstract: Actions in expert demonstrations exhibit temporal structure. An ordered-versus-shuffled analysis across five environments confirms this dependence. We ask whether action proposals that better reflect expert continuity can improve visual world-model planning. Rather than imposing generic smoothness, we learn continuations from the temporal structure of demonstrated actions. Our locality-gated deep-kernel Gaussian-process prior, LG-DKGP, combines recent and longer-range executed action history, predicts a neural continuation, and learns a temporal Gaussian-process (GP) residual. A training-derived exploration scale initializes search around the corrected mean; a frozen world model evaluates progress toward the goal. Training first fits the neural mean, then jointly optimizes the prior with the GP residual using expert future actions. The resulting planner achieves 87.07\% macro success across five simulated tasks spanning native and fragment-level goal attainment, compared with 71.03\% for INTACT, 61.66\% for PRISM, and 58.66\% for LeWM. Component interventions and expert-relative action-structure comparisons support demonstration-informed continuations and reveal task-dependent effects of visual conditioning, history length, and planning horizon.

ai_summary.problem: 论文研究如何利用专家演示动作中的时间连续性结构，来改进基于视觉世界模型的规划与动作提议质量。
ai_summary.method: 提出 LG-DKGP：一种局部门控的深度核高斯过程先验，融合近期与更长程的动作历史，预测神经网络动作延续，并学习时间高斯过程残差；用训练得到的探索尺度初始化搜索，并由冻结世界模型评估目标进展。训练先拟合神经均值，再结合专家未来动作联合优化 GP 残差。
ai_summary.result: 在五个模拟任务上取得 87.07% 宏平均成功率，显著高于 INTACT 的 71.03%、PRISM 的 61.66% 和 LeWM 的 58.66%；消融与动作结构比较支持演示驱动的动作延续先验，并揭示视觉条件、历史长度和规划视野的任务依赖效应。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是从专家演示动作的时间结构中学习连续性先验，而非施加通用平滑约束，并将其用于世界模型规划。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作表明动作时间结构与演示先验可显著提升世界模型规划，对具身智能和基于模型的决策研究有参考价值。

papers.title: Reins: Frontier Multimodal Models Driving Real Robot Arms on Long-Horizon Tasks, Zero-Shot
papers.abstract: Frontier models such as GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 can now plan and call tools, yet they still struggle to drive real robots through long-horizon, contact-rich manipulation, blind while the arm moves and while they think. We present Reins, a harness in which an off-the-shelf model operates a dual-arm robot with 3D perception tools and atomic actions that report contact and grip. The model chains actions in one call, each with a condition that must hold, stopping at the first that fails; a second instance, the narrator, watches the cameras continuously and reports what changed with every result. From images, Reins also builds a simulation-ready twin of the scene for continual policy learning. With natural-language prompts and no task-specific code, GPT-6.1 Sol succeeds in 88% of real episodes on five tasks; without the harness, it fails every shell game, taking 8 times as long. Three frontier models perform alike but differ in tracking a scene that changes while the actor thinks. Code will be released upon publication.

ai_summary.problem: 前沿多模态大模型虽能规划和调用工具，却难以零样本驱动真实机械臂完成长时程、富接触的操作任务；而且机械臂运动时以及模型思考时都处于“盲”状态，缺乏对场景变化的持续感知与失败反馈。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Reins：一种把现成前沿模型与双臂机器人结合的执行框架，为模型提供 3D 感知工具，以及能回报接触与抓取状态的原子动作；模型在一次调用中串联多个带前置条件的动作，一旦某条件不满足即停止，并由第二个模型实例（narrator，旁白）持续观看摄像头，报告每个结果带来的场景变化；此外，Reins 可从图像构建可仿真的场景数字孪生，用于持续的策略学习。
ai_summary.result: 在无需任务专用代码、仅用自然语言提示的情况下，GPT-6.1 Sol 在五个真实任务的实机实验中成功率达 88%；去掉该框架后，它在所有 shell game 任务上均失败，且耗时增至 8 倍。三个前沿模型整体表现相近，但在“执行者思考期间场景发生变化”的跟踪能力上存在差异。
ai_summary.novelty: 用一个“动作-前置条件链 + 持续旁白反馈 + 自动构建仿真孪生”的 harness，把通用前沿模型零样本变成可靠的真实机器人长时程操作控制器。
ai_summary.relevance: 证明了通用多模态大模型无需专门训练即可通过合适的执行框架操控真实机器人，为通用具身智能体和长时程机器人任务提供了可复用的系统范式。

papers.title: Safety as a Budget: Calibrating the Control Channel of Constrained GRPO for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning can teach vision-language models (VLMs) to decline harmful image-text requests, but how safe the result becomes is set indirectly, through reward weights found by trial runs. Stating safety as budgets on the rate of harmful assistance and the rate of over-refusal, enforced by Lagrange multipliers inside GRPO with an off-the-shelf scorer as the cost, is the natural fix, and it fails twice. The multiplier compares the scorer's mean with the budget, and scorers built for ranking get the mean wrong: a fixed-point analysis shows that the mean bias, not the budget, then decides whether the multiplier settles, saturates or switches off. And standard GRPO standardizes the penalized reward within each group, which cancels the multiplier before it reaches the gradient. Two-channel constrained GRPO repairs both: the base reward keeps the raw score for the within-group comparison, the penalty and the constraint estimate pass through a monotone map fitted on judge-labeled training responses, and the advantage keeps the multiplier. On a Qwen3-VL-2B policy with a training-free readout of an open 4B model as the scorer, held-out harm on 1,037 adversarial prompts falls from 8.9% under standard GRPO to 4.8%, lower in every seed, where the uncalibrated budget gives 7.6%; over-refusal stays at most 2% on 400 benign queries and MMBench is unchanged. The gain is largest where the intent sits in the image (10.1% -> 5.1%) and grows on the unseen HADES benchmark (28.9% -> 12.8%). Order-preserving distortions of the scores reproduce each predicted controller state in every seed, and the results hold under a map fitted on another judge's labels, an image-reading judge and a human audit.

ai_summary.problem: 论文要解决如何在视觉语言模型（VLM）中通过强化学习可靠地控制安全性，而不是依赖试错得到的奖励权重；同时指出直接用 Lagrange 乘子做约束 GRPO 会因评分器均值偏差和组内标准化而失效。
ai_summary.method: 提出两通道约束 GRPO：基础奖励保留原始分数用于组内比较，惩罚项与约束估计通过一个在裁判标注训练响应上拟合的单调映射传递，并让优势函数保留 Lagrange 乘子，从而把有害协助率和过度拒答率作为预算进行校准控制。
ai_summary.result: 在 Qwen3-VL-2B 上，使用开放 4B 模型作为免训练评分器，1,037 条对抗提示上的留出有害率从标准 GRPO 的 8.9% 降至 4.8%（每个随机种子都更低，未校准预算为 7.6%）；400 条良性查询上过度拒答不超过 2%，MMBench 不变；图像承载意图场景从 10.1% 降至 5.1%，未见 HADES 基准从 28.9% 降至 12.8%，并有多评分器与人工审计鲁棒性验证。
ai_summary.novelty: 识别并修复了约束 GRPO 中评分器均值偏差导致乘子失控、以及组内标准化抵消乘子的两个机制性问题，提出可校准的安全预算控制通道。
ai_summary.relevance: 为 VLM 安全对齐提供了更可控、可复现的约束强化学习方案，使安全预算从间接调参变为可校准的训练目标。

papers.title: STVLA: Spatial-aware and Temporal-memory forVision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation often requires both spatial scene understanding and task history. However, many vision-language-action (VLA) policies rely primarily on current observations, without explicitly integrating spatial structure and task history. Appearance-based memories can be sensitive to occlusion and viewpoint changes, while spatial representations of the current scene alone do not preserve how the scene has changed during task execution. We introduce STVLA, a framework that incorporates features from a pretrained visual geometry foundation model into temporal memory alongside visual representations. This allows the policy to recall past scene structure as context for current action decisions. To select informative history, STVLA uses a mathematically grounded scoring rule that balances relevance to the current observation with complementary evidence from memory. Across evaluations on LIBERO, LIBERO-Mem, MIKASA-Robo, and SimplerEnv Bridge, STVLA achieves the highest average success rate among the compared methods on each benchmark. On real-world block stacking, object organization, and phone packaging, it improves success over $π_{0.5}$ by $58.33$, $30.00$, and $35.00$ percentage points, respectively. These results support integrating scene geometry into temporal memory to improve manipulation requiring both spatial precision and task history. Project website: \href{https://stvla.github.io/}{https://stvla.github.io/}

ai_summary.problem: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略主要依赖当前观测，缺乏对空间结构和任务历史的显式建模：基于外观的记忆对遮挡和视角变化敏感，而仅用当前场景的空间表征又无法记录场景在任务执行中的变化。
ai_summary.method: STVLA 将预训练视觉几何基础模型提取的空间特征与视觉表征一起纳入时序记忆，使策略能够回溯过往场景结构作为当前动作决策的上下文；并设计了一个有数学依据的打分规则，在选择历史信息时平衡其与当前观测的相关性和记忆中的互补证据。
ai_summary.result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Mem、MIKASA-Robo 和 SimplerEnv Bridge 四个基准上，STVLA 的平均成功率均为对比方法中最高；在真实世界的积木堆叠、物体整理和手机包装任务上，相比 π_{0.5} 分别提升 58.33、30.00 和 35.00 个百分点。
ai_summary.novelty: 将预训练视觉几何基础模型的空间特征引入时序记忆，并用数学化的打分机制筛选互补的历史空间信息，使策略同时具备空间精度与任务历史感知能力。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能/VLA 模型融合三维空间理解与长时序记忆提供了有效范式，对需要空间精度和任务历史回忆的机器人操作任务具有直接推动意义。

papers.title: HEIR: Harness Egocentric Intent for Human-Robot Interactions
papers.abstract: For robots to assist, serve, and collaborate with humans, they must not only interpret human requests conveyed through language and multimodal intentional cues, but also execute long-horizon tasks that interleave navigation and manipulation. In this paper, we introduce HEIR, a resource for studying how to Harness Egocentric Intent for Human-Robot Interaction. HEIR pairs human speech, measured gaze, and egocentric video with robot observations and teleoperated navigation-manipulation trajectories, while each session preserves successive episodes, with each request fulfilled through multiple execution subtasks. The captured data, together with human-authored annotations, support the study of intent grounding, execution planning, and task completion within a unified interaction setting. To demonstrate the value of HEIR, we conduct extensive offline experiments to evaluate how models benefit from additional human-centric context across these tasks, together with real-robot experiments that assess execution task completion. HEIR thus provides a valuable resource for studying user-centric robot interaction in naturalistic household environments. Our demo and dataset are available online.

ai_summary.problem: 机器人在家庭环境中协助人类时，需要理解通过语言和多模态意图线索（如目光）传达的请求，并执行导航与操作交错的长时程任务；现有资源缺乏将人类以自我为中心的多模态意图与机器人长时程执行轨迹对齐的数据。
ai_summary.method: 提出 HEIR 数据集/资源，将人类语音、实测注视点、自我中心（egocentric）视频与机器人观测及遥操作的导航-操作轨迹配对；每个会话保留连续多个回合，每个请求由多个执行子任务完成，并提供人工标注，支撑意图落地、执行规划与任务完成的研究。
ai_summary.result: 通过大量离线实验验证模型如何从额外的人类中心上下文（语音、注视等）中受益，并配合真机实验评估执行任务的完成情况，证明 HEIR 是研究自然家庭环境下以用户为中心的机器人交互的有价值资源。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将人类的自我中心多模态意图线索（语音+注视+egocentric 视频）与机器人长时程导航-操作轨迹在多回合连续会话中统一对齐并开放数据集与演示。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能与人机交互中的意图理解、长时程规划与多模态基础研究提供了贴近真实家庭场景的基准数据资源。

papers.title: Validation-Guided Prompt Selection for Differential Morphing Attack Detection
papers.abstract: Differential morphing attack detection (D-MAD) compares a trusted live capture with a document image that may contain a facial morph. We investigate whether labelled validation data can improve a frozen-parameter vision-language evaluator through prompt selection rather than model fine-tuning. Version~1 generates 50 candidate prompts and selects the top-ranked instruction using a security-oriented loss that prioritises missed morph attacks (MACER) while accounting for bona fide classification errors (BSCER), response failures, parse failures, and decision inconsistency. Version~2 recursively revises prompts using aggregate validation feedback. On a subject-disjoint test set of 160 pairs spanning LMA, MIPGAN-2, and PIPE, the selected Version~1 prompt achieves a (19.17\%) morph attack classification error rate (MACER), with (0.00\%) observed bona fide sample classification error rate (BSCER), compared with (70.00\%) MACER for a controlled manual prompt. The paired (50.83) percentage-point difference has a (95\%) subject-bootstrap interval of ([43.33,58.33]). Recursive revision does not surpass the best Generation~0 validation loss; the reported revised descendant obtains (31.67\%) test MACER. All 23 attacks missed by Version~1 are landmark-based (LMA) morphs. Overall, the results show that prompt formulation can substantially influence frozen-parameter VLM-based D-MAD performance, while also highlighting the challenge of recursive prompt refinement under a compact 10-subject validation setting.

ai_summary.problem: 研究在冻结参数的视觉语言模型（VLM）用于差分变形攻击检测（D-MAD）时，能否通过基于标注验证集的提示选择来提升检测性能，而不是微调模型。
ai_summary.method: 提出验证引导的提示选择方法：Version 1 生成50个候选提示，并用面向安全的损失（优先降低漏检变形攻击的MACER，同时考虑BSCER、响应失败、解析失败和决策不一致）选择最佳指令；Version 2 利用验证集聚合反馈递归修订提示。
ai_summary.result: 在160对、跨LMA/MIPGAN-2/PIPE且受试者不重叠的测试集上，Version 1选出的提示达到19.17% MACER和0.00% BSCER，而受控人工提示MACER为70.00%；递归修订未超过最佳初始验证损失，修订后测试MACER为31.67%。所有23个漏检攻击均为基于关键点的LMA变形。
ai_summary.novelty: 将验证集驱动的提示选择而非模型微调用于冻结VLM的差分变形攻击检测，并系统评估提示公式对安全性能的影响。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明提示工程可显著影响冻结VLM在生物特征安全检测中的表现，同时揭示小规模验证集下递归提示优化的困难。

papers.title: HiVE-VQA: Hierarchical Interaction via Volumetric Embedding for Video Quality Assessment
papers.abstract: The proliferation of user-generated video content has made accurate and robust no-reference video quality assessment (NR-VQA) a highly important challenge. Existing research increasingly relies on architecturally complex multi-branch pipelines or computationally intensive fine-tuning of single-branch backbones. In this paper, we investigate whether a single frozen video foundation model can serve as an effective NR-VQA backbone, and propose HiVE-VQA, the first framework (to our knowledge) to apply a JEPA-based video encoder to this task. HiVE-VQA extracts token grids from multiple depths of a pre-trained V-JEPA 2.1 encoder and stacks them into a hierarchical spatio-temporal volume, which a compact 3D convolutional head fuses across its layer, spatial, and temporal axes, combining low-level distortion cues from shallow layers with the semantic and temporal context captured at greater depths. The encoder remains frozen throughout, so only the head is trained: 5.2M parameters (5.7\% of the total), with no auxiliary multi-modal models and an inference cost that is invariant to video resolution. Trained solely on LSVQ and evaluated without any fine-tuning, HiVE-VQA outperforms 17 state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods in SROCC and PLCC on both intra-dataset (LSVQ-test, LSVQ-1080p) and cross-dataset (KoNViD-1k, LIVE-VQC) benchmarks. These results indicate that hierarchical, depth-wise fusion of features from a single frozen video foundation model provides a more effective and efficient basis for NR-VQA than task-specific multi-network fusion. Code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/RobHam99/HiVE-VQA.

ai_summary.problem: 无参考视频质量评估（NR-VQA）现有方法依赖复杂的多分支流水线或对单分支骨干网络进行昂贵的微调，论文要探究单个冻结视频基础模型能否作为高效的 NR-VQA 骨干。
ai_summary.method: 提出 HiVE-VQA：从冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 视频编码器多个深度提取 token 网格，堆叠成层次化时空体（hierarchical spatio-temporal volume），再用轻量 3D 卷积头沿层、空间、时间三个轴融合，结合浅层失真线索与深层语义/时序上下文；编码器全程冻结，仅训练 5.2M 参数（占总量 5.7%）的头部。
ai_summary.result: 仅在 LSVQ 上训练、不做任何微调，即在数据集内（LSVQ-test、LSVQ-1080p）和跨数据集（KoNViD-1k、LIVE-VQC）的 SROCC 与 PLCC 上超越 17 个 SOTA 方法，且推理开销与视频分辨率无关。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将 JEPA 类视频编码器用于 NR-VQA，并提出对冻结骨干多深度特征做层次化体堆叠与 3D 融合的轻量范式，替代任务特定的多网络融合。
ai_summary.relevance: 证明了冻结视频基础模型加轻量头的层次化特征融合可优于复杂专用流水线，为视频理解与质量评估提供了高效、可复用的大模型利用思路。
ai_summary.org: 推测为布里斯托大学（University of Bristol，作者 Robbie Hamilton、Fan Zhang、David Bull 隶属其视觉信息实验室）

papers.title: Scale-Induced Semantic Shift in Visual Prompt Injection Against VLMs and Web Agents
papers.abstract: Visual content in multimedia systems may be resized, compressed, or re-rendered before it is interpreted by a vision-language model. We study a security failure mode in which these transformations change the machine-readable semantics of an image: a textual instruction is not recovered at a $512\times512$ presentation resolution under our evaluation protocol but becomes recoverable after aggressive downsampling. We formulate this behavior as Scale-Induced Semantic Shift (SISS) and develop a closed-loop black-box framework that combines dual-scale verification, selective self-hardening, shallow-layer low-rank adaptation, and pixel-space noise regularization. On a fixed 300-case benchmark, the third SISS refinement round obtains a $58.75\%$ average attack success rate across four closed-source vision-language models, compared with $41.08\%$ for the strongest generation baseline. A controlled sweep bounds the effect to aggressive compression: average success decreases to $17.68\%$, $6.85\%$, and $5.60\%$ at $128\times128$, $224\times224$, and $336\times336$, respectively. In a downstream web-agent study, the generated images increase hidden-instruction perception, but absolute behavioral compromise remains about $4\%$. Generic input transformations provide little protection in a separate defense protocol, whereas the proposed ScaleGuard consistency detector reduces non-adaptive success from $61.4\%$ to $24.3\%$ and one-round defense-aware success from $42.5\%$ to $15.0\%$, with no observed rejection among matched clean controls. The results characterize a bounded but reproducible semantic inconsistency in multimedia preprocessing and motivate scale-consistent visual-language inference.

ai_summary.problem: 多媒体系统中的图像在送入视觉语言模型前常被缩放、压缩或重渲染，本文研究这种预处理变换会改变图像机器可读语义的安全失效模式——文本指令在512×512分辨率下不可恢复，但经激进下采样后却变得可恢复（尺度诱导语义漂移，SISS）。
ai_summary.method: 提出闭环黑盒框架，结合双尺度验证、选择性自硬化、浅层低秩适配与像素空间噪声正则来生成具有尺度依赖性的注入图像；同时提出ScaleGuard一致性检测器作为防御，通过跨尺度语义一致性判别可疑输入。
ai_summary.result: 在固定300例基准上，第三轮SISS精炼在四个闭源VLM上取得58.75%平均攻击成功率（最强基线41.08%），但效应局限于激进压缩（128/224/336分辨率下分别降至17.68%/6.85%/5.60%）；下游Web Agent中隐藏指令感知提升，但实际行为劫持仅约4%。ScaleGuard将非自适应成功率从61.4%降至24.3%、防御感知单轮从42.5%降至15.0%，且干净对照无误拒。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将预处理尺度变换导致的语义漂移形式化为可复现的安全失效模式（SISS），并给出闭环攻击框架与尺度一致性防御方案。
ai_summary.relevance: 揭示了多模态系统与Web Agent在图像预处理环节的语义不一致风险，推动尺度一致的视觉-语言推理与更鲁棒的多模态安全防御研究。

papers.title: MusicRWKV: A Multimodal RWKV Framework for Music Representation Learning
papers.abstract: Recent music foundation models have achieved remarkable progress in music representation learning, yet most existing approaches rely on Transformer architectures whose quadratic attention complexity introduces substantial computational and memory overhead when modeling long-duration music recordings. In this work, we propose MusicRWKV, a multimodal music representation learning framework built upon the RWKV architecture. MusicRWKV jointly models waveform, spectrogram, and metadata information within a unified self-supervised learning framework. To improve efficiency for long musical sequences, we introduce an invertible compression module that reduces sequence length while preserving reconstruction capability. A FiLM-based conditioning strategy is employed to facilitate modality-aware representation learning without introducing expensive cross-attention operations. We further investigate the integration of Soft ROSA as a differentiable retrieval mechanism for neural-symbolic interaction. Experimental evaluation across a diverse collection of Music Information Retrieval (MIR) benchmarks demonstrates that the proposed RWKV-based architecture can be effectively adapted to heterogeneous music understanding tasks. A controlled pretraining ablation shows that Soft ROSA improves validation performance, while layer-wise telemetry analysis reveals a progressive transition from distributed retrieval to selective retrieval in deeper network layers. These results suggest that RWKV provides a promising architectural alternative to Transformer-based models for multimodal music understanding.

ai_summary.problem: 现有音乐基础模型多依赖 Transformer，其二次注意力复杂度在建模长时间音乐录音时带来显著计算和内存开销；本文旨在探索更高效的多模态音乐表示学习框架。
ai_summary.method: 提出 MusicRWKV，基于 RWKV 架构统一建模波形、频谱图和元数据，并进行自监督学习；引入可逆压缩模块缩短长序列且保留重建能力，采用 FiLM 条件策略实现模态感知表示学习，并探索 Soft ROSA 作为可微分检索机制用于神经-符号交互。
ai_summary.result: 在多个 MIR 基准上验证了 RWKV 架构可适配异构音乐理解任务；受控预训练消融显示 Soft ROSA 提升验证性能，逐层分析揭示从分布式检索到选择性检索的渐进转变。
ai_summary.novelty: 将 RWKV、可逆序列压缩、FiLM 模态条件与 Soft ROSA 检索机制结合，用于高效多模态音乐表示学习。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明 RWKV 可作为 Transformer 之外的有前景架构选择，用于长序列多模态音乐理解及其他高效序列建模场景。

papers.title: MuViRL: Multimodal View-Invariant Visual Speech Representation Learning via Calibrated View Aggregation
papers.abstract: Multimodal representation learning combines complementary signals to capture shared semantic information. For dynamic scenes, these representations need to remain consistent across views while preserving distinctions between temporal states. In visual speech representation learning, view variation changes the visibility and reliability of articulation cues, making it difficult to learn such representations from synchronized audio and video. To address this challenge, we propose MuViRL, a self-supervised framework for multimodal view-invariant visual speech representation learning via calibrated view aggregation. The framework combines synchronized 3D Gaussian view synthesis with multimodal self-supervision to learn consistent representations from real and synthesized data. A multimodal decision model learns relative view utility from teacher prediction losses, and its calibrated scores guide the aggregation of complementary information. Aggregation-to-Single Distillation transfers the aggregated predictions to a single branch. Real-synthetic alignment matches synchronized windows across views while preserving their temporal relations. Experiments on real and synthesized multiview data demonstrate that MuViRL improves multimodal representation consistency and visual speech recognition performance across views.

ai_summary.problem: 在视觉语音表征学习中，视角变化会改变发音线索的可见性与可靠性，导致难以从同步的音视频中学习到既跨视角一致、又能区分不同时间状态的多模态表征。
ai_summary.method: 提出自监督框架 MuViRL，将同步的 3D 高斯视角合成与多模态自监督结合，利用真实与合成数据学习一致表征；通过多模态决策模型从教师预测损失中学习各视角的相对效用，并用校准分数引导互补信息聚合；再用聚合到单分支蒸馏将聚合预测迁移到单分支，并通过真实-合成对齐在保持时间关系的同时匹配跨视角同步窗口。
ai_summary.result: 在真实与合成的多视角数据上，MuViRL 提升了多模态表征的一致性和跨视角视觉语音识别性能。
ai_summary.novelty: 将校准后的视角效用评估与 3D 高斯视角合成、自监督蒸馏结合，实现视角不变的视觉语音表征聚合。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多视角、多模态场景下的视角不变表征学习提供了可借鉴的聚合与蒸馏范式，对多模态大模型与具身感知中的鲁棒表征学习有参考价值。

papers.title: InertiaMPDD: Multimodal Personalized Depression Detection via Emotional Inertia-Inspired Dynamics Modeling
papers.abstract: Multimodal depression screening estimates risk from speech, visual behavior and language. Current methods mainly predict labels, with limited evidence of departures from a non-depressed reference. Recording-level supervision also leaves fine-grained emotional dynamics unannotated. Motivated by emotional inertia, the persistence of affect, InertiaMPDD learns healthy next-state patterns using a world-model-inspired latent predictor. Using pretrained multimodal representations, it predicts from observed history and context. Reference deviation, residual decay rate and a Jacobian spectral descriptor form reference-derived emotional dynamics descriptors, evaluated as candidate proxy biomarkers for standalone screening and personalized decision correction. Across five cohorts from four datasets, fusion reaches 98.41% F1 on D-Vlog and 84.98% on LMVD. Standalone descriptors outperform fixed additive fusion on MPDD but discriminate weakly on AVEC2014. These findings distinguish reference informativeness from fusion benefit and reveal context-dependent utility.

ai_summary.problem: 现有多模态抑郁筛查主要直接预测标签，缺乏对偏离健康参考状态的证据，且记录级监督难以刻画细粒度情绪动态。
ai_summary.method: 受情感惯性启发，作者提出InertiaMPDD，用世界模型启发的潜在预测器基于预训练多模态表示学习健康下一状态模式。方法进一步构造参考偏差、残差衰减率和Jacobian谱描述符，作为候选代理生物标志物，用于独立筛查和个性化决策校正。
ai_summary.result: 在四个数据集的五个队列上，融合方法在D-Vlog达到98.41% F1、LMVD达到84.98% F1；独立描述符在MPDD上优于固定加性融合，但在AVEC2014上判别较弱，说明其效用依赖上下文。
ai_summary.novelty: 将情感惯性与世界模型式潜在预测结合，用参考偏离动态描述符实现可解释的个性化抑郁筛查与决策校正。

papers.title: Report of the 8th LSVOS Challenge: Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding
papers.abstract: This report summarizes the Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding (MUMU) track of the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge, held in conjunction with ECCV 2026. MUMU asks for a single unified model that jointly performs multi-concept image tagging over quality, scene, and event vocabularies, open-vocabulary object detection, and concise image captioning, within a budget of 0.5B parameters and 8 GB of peak inference memory. Submissions are ranked by a weighted task score scaled by an efficiency factor. We describe the tasks, rules, and evaluation protocol, report the final results, and review the methods of the top three teams. All three leading solutions build on the compact Florence-2-base model, but extend it in different ways: lightweight tagging heads with cross-task inference refinement, a shared low-rank adapter trained on coverage-aware multi-source data with task-dependent decoding, and a training-free pipeline that maps captions to tags and applies detection test-time augmentation. The results show that a compact prompt-based vision-language model can serve all three outputs when supervision, decoding, and cross-task cues are designed for each task, while open-vocabulary detection on novel categories remains the main bottleneck.

ai_summary.problem: 该挑战赛要求单一统一模型在0.5B参数和8GB峰值推理内存预算内，同时完成多概念图像标签、开放词汇目标检测和简洁图像描述。
ai_summary.method: 报告介绍了MUMU赛道任务、规则与评测协议，并总结前三名方法：均基于Florence-2-base，分别采用轻量标签头与跨任务推理优化、覆盖感知多源数据训练的共享低秩适配器与任务相关解码、以及免训练的描述到标签映射和检测测试时增强。
ai_summary.result: 结果表明紧凑的提示式视觉语言模型在针对各任务设计监督、解码和跨任务线索时可同时支持三类输出，但新类别上的开放词汇检测仍是主要瓶颈。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出并系统评测移动端统一多模态理解挑战设定，并归纳高效统一模型在标签、检测和描述任务上的可行设计路径。
ai_summary.relevance: 为移动端高效统一多模态模型提供基准与经验，并指出开放词汇检测是未来关键改进方向。

papers.title: Predicting Ethanol Drinking Status from Nonhuman Primate Liver Histology: A Proof of Concept for Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning in Few-Shot Vision-Language Modeling
papers.abstract: Combining vision-language models (VLMs) with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) offers a promising approach to few-shot whole-slide image (WSI) classification in computational pathology. This study evaluates this approach for predicting ethanol drinking status from nonhuman primate liver histology. Adapters are evaluated against non-PEFT configurations on a subset of the Monkey Alcohol Tissue Research Resource (MATRR). All evaluated PEFT configurations achieve higher mean balanced accuracy than the non-PEFT baselines. For example, in the four-shot setting, attention-based multiple instance learning (ABMIL) alone achieves 43.5% mean balanced accuracy, compared with 78.1% after adding an adapter. Qualitative attention analysis shows that textual pathway adaptations produce localized attention heatmaps, while visual pathway adaptations produce more diffuse ones. A pathologist's review identified similar histological features across adaptations.

ai_summary.problem: 该论文研究能否利用视觉-语言模型结合参数高效微调，在少样本条件下从非人灵长类肝脏组织病理图像预测乙醇饮酒状态。
ai_summary.method: 研究在MATRR数据集子集上比较Adapter等PEFT配置与非PEFT基线，并采用ABMIL进行全切片图像分类；同时通过注意力图定性分析文本通路与视觉通路适配的差异。
ai_summary.result: 所有评估的PEFT配置平均平衡准确率均高于非PEFT基线；例如四样本设置下，ABMIL单独为43.5%，加入Adapter后提升至78.1%。注意力分析显示文本通路适配产生更局部化的热图，视觉通路适配更弥散，病理学家认为不同适配识别出的组织学特征相似。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将参数高效微调视觉-语言模型用于少样本非人灵长类肝脏组织学预测乙醇饮酒状态，并比较不同适配通路的注意力行为。
ai_summary.relevance: 为计算病理学中的少样本全切片图像分类提供了PEFT-VLM的概念验证，并提示不同模态适配对模型注意力的影响。
ai_summary.org: 给定信息未提供作者机构，无法可靠识别

papers.title: AgriSense: Vision-Language Decision Support and Robotic Intervention in a Virtual Greenhouse Copy title
papers.abstract: Autonomous greenhouse management increasingly requires robotic systems that integrate perception, navigation, environmental regulation, and plant-level intervention. This paper presents AgriSense, a framework combining an Isaac Sim virtual greenhouse, a quadruped mobile manipulator, RGB and LiDAR-inertial sensing, environmental control, and supervised vision-language decision support. Frozen DINOv2 and BERT encoders, together with structured environmental inputs, support joint prediction of twelve environmental references, a target zone, and an intervention flag. Checkpoint replay reproduces 41/43 zone decisions. Across five seeds on a source-grouped test set, the full, image-removed, and language-removed configurations each achieve 43/44 correct zone decisions, providing no evidence of incremental multimodal zone-accuracy improvement. The full model achieves mean absolute errors of 0.249 degrees C for temperature, 2.030 percentage points for humidity, and 0.997 percentage points for soil moisture. Sensor-only inputs match full-model zone accuracy, while language-only inputs achieve 68.64%. External real-image benchmarks reveal distribution-shift limitations. Five offline Point-LIO routes yield rigidly aligned trajectory errors of 5.22-17.32 mm. Of 40 virtual-arm targets, 32 satisfy geometric acceptance criteria and eight are rejected at boundaries. Six long-horizon climate cases and fault protocols characterize integration limits. Navigation and integrated treatment rely on simulator-state inputs; physical greenhouse performance and agronomic treatment efficacy remain unvalidated. The contribution is an evaluated decision-support and robotic-intervention framework for a virtual greenhouse.

ai_summary.problem: 如何在虚拟温室中构建一个集感知、导航、环境调控与植株级干预于一体的机器人决策支持系统，并评估视觉-语言多模态融合是否真正带来增益。
ai_summary.method: 在 Isaac Sim 中搭建虚拟温室，使用四足移动机械臂与 RGB、LiDAR-惯性传感，采用冻结的 DINOv2 与 BERT 编码器结合结构化环境输入，联合预测 12 个环境参考值、目标区域和干预标志；通过消融（去图像、去语言、仅传感器）与离线 Point-LIO 轨迹、机械臂几何验收、长时序气候与故障协议进行评估。
ai_summary.result: 完整模型温度 MAE 为 0.249°C、湿度 2.030 个百分点、土壤湿度 0.997 个百分点；但完整、去图像、去语言三种配置在分组测试集上均为 43/44 区域决策正确，未能证明多模态带来增量收益，仅传感器输入已可匹敌完整模型，仅语言输入为 68.64%；真实图像基准显示存在分布偏移问题，所有验证均在仿真中完成，物理温室与农艺效果未经验证。
ai_summary.novelty: 在统一的虚拟温室平台中整合四足移动操作、多模态决策支持与机械臂干预，并以严谨消融给出多模态融合无增益的负向证据。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能与机器人-视觉语言模型研究提供了仿真集成范式和诚实的负结果参考，但缺乏真实世界验证，实用价值有限。

key_lab_papers.title: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
key_lab_papers.abstract: How multimodal language models should encode visual input remains up for debate. Most models use a pretrained vision encoder, while some recent recipes train the encoder from scratch with the language model or remove it entirely. Vision encoders bundle together three design choices: a visual prior from upstream pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and pre-fusion placement of that capacity (i.e., before the multimodal backbone). Because published models also differ in data, architecture, and compute, comparing them cannot isolate the effect of each choice. We disentangle these choices via a controlled framework where we pretrain all models from scratch on common data and compare them on visual question answering and language benchmarks at matched lifetime compute. We find that the visual prior is not necessary; an encoder trained jointly from scratch is on par with a pretrained one, without a separate training stage. What matters instead is dedicated vision capacity: an encoder-free model trails on visual understanding even when its backbone is enlarged by the encoder's parameter count. Yet that capacity need not precede multimodal fusion, as vision-only modules added in-fusion to early backbone layers perform comparably to a pre-fusion encoder and can lower time to first token. These results also hold across backbone sizes, when encoder pretraining is treated as free, and when starting from a pretrained language model. Overall, our findings favor dedicated vision capacity trained jointly with the backbone and placed early within it.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态语言模型应如何编码视觉输入仍无定论，已有模型在视觉先验、专用视觉容量和融合前放置等设计上相互纠缠，难以隔离各自影响。
ai_summary.method: 作者提出一个受控实验框架，在相同数据和匹配的总训练计算下从零预训练所有模型，并在视觉问答与语言基准上比较不同设计选择，同时覆盖不同骨干规模、将编码器预训练视为免费以及从预训练语言模型初始化等设定。
ai_summary.result: 实验发现预训练视觉先验并非必要，从零联合训练的编码器可与预训练编码器相当；真正关键的是专用视觉容量，而无编码器模型即使扩大骨干参数量仍在视觉理解上落后；该容量不必置于多模态融合之前，早期骨干层内融合的纯视觉模块表现相当并可降低首 token 延迟。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过受控框架解耦并分别检验视觉先验、专用视觉容量和融合前放置这三个常被混在一起的设计选择。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态模型视觉编码架构提供了可操作的实证指导，支持将专用视觉容量与骨干联合训练并早期置于骨干内部。
ai_summary.org: Meta AI（FAIR）

key_lab_papers.title: Reins: Frontier Multimodal Models Driving Real Robot Arms on Long-Horizon Tasks, Zero-Shot
key_lab_papers.abstract: Frontier models such as GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 can now plan and call tools, yet they still struggle to drive real robots through long-horizon, contact-rich manipulation, blind while the arm moves and while they think. We present Reins, a harness in which an off-the-shelf model operates a dual-arm robot with 3D perception tools and atomic actions that report contact and grip. The model chains actions in one call, each with a condition that must hold, stopping at the first that fails; a second instance, the narrator, watches the cameras continuously and reports what changed with every result. From images, Reins also builds a simulation-ready twin of the scene for continual policy learning. With natural-language prompts and no task-specific code, GPT-6.1 Sol succeeds in 88% of real episodes on five tasks; without the harness, it fails every shell game, taking 8 times as long. Three frontier models perform alike but differ in tracking a scene that changes while the actor thinks. Code will be released upon publication.

ai_summary.problem: 前沿多模态大模型虽能规划和调用工具，却难以零样本驱动真实机械臂完成长时程、富接触的操作任务；而且机械臂运动时以及模型思考时都处于“盲”状态，缺乏对场景变化的持续感知与失败反馈。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Reins：一种把现成前沿模型与双臂机器人结合的执行框架，为模型提供 3D 感知工具，以及能回报接触与抓取状态的原子动作；模型在一次调用中串联多个带前置条件的动作，一旦某条件不满足即停止，并由第二个模型实例（narrator，旁白）持续观看摄像头，报告每个结果带来的场景变化；此外，Reins 可从图像构建可仿真的场景数字孪生，用于持续的策略学习。
ai_summary.result: 在无需任务专用代码、仅用自然语言提示的情况下，GPT-6.1 Sol 在五个真实任务的实机实验中成功率达 88%；去掉该框架后，它在所有 shell game 任务上均失败，且耗时增至 8 倍。三个前沿模型整体表现相近，但在“执行者思考期间场景发生变化”的跟踪能力上存在差异。
ai_summary.novelty: 用一个“动作-前置条件链 + 持续旁白反馈 + 自动构建仿真孪生”的 harness，把通用前沿模型零样本变成可靠的真实机器人长时程操作控制器。
ai_summary.relevance: 证明了通用多模态大模型无需专门训练即可通过合适的执行框架操控真实机器人，为通用具身智能体和长时程机器人任务提供了可复用的系统范式。
ai_summary.org: 未提供（作者机构信息缺失）

daily_insight.hot_topics: 今日20篇论文中17篇标注多模态，核心趋势是从“模态对齐”走向“多模态能力的解耦与结构化分解”：Meta解耦视觉编码设计变量，JEPA类工作拆分共享与私有信息，VLM被注入3D几何先验。同时多模态与具身智能、机器人长时程操作和世界模型规划的交叉明显升温，安全侧出现VLM提示注入的新失效模式研究。
daily_insight.lab_overlap: Meta与Anthropic均只发1篇且同属多模态，但方向不重叠：Meta聚焦视觉编码器的受控解耦分析，属理解侧的基础架构归因研究；Anthropic的Reins则把前沿多模态模型零样本用于真实机械臂长时程操作，属具身控制侧的系统harness工程。二者是互补关系——前者提供编码设计准则，后者验证通用模型的下游控制可靠性，暂无直接方法竞争。
daily_insight.signals: 三个信号：一是JEPA/自监督范式外溢，被同时用于非对称多模态学习和视频质量评估；二是VLA与空间-时序记忆成为密集创新点（STVLA、XBot-Omni、Reins），显示通用前沿模型零样本接管机器人控制正在成为新路线；三是出现明确负向证据（AgriSense报告多模态融合无增益）和尺度诱导语义漂移（SISS）等安全失效模式，提示多模态融合的收益边界与攻击面正被系统审视。
